title: Luxury East Side Private Hideaway
description:
This 2 Bed, 1 Bath apartment (approximately 700 sq. Ft)  is 1.5 miles from Downtown Nashville. Located between historic Broadway and the local favorite 5 points neighborhood. This mid-century modern retreat will be the perfect balance of Nashville city life and quiet neighborhood. Walkable to both acclaimed restaurants, local nightlife and a quick uber ride to all that Nashville has to offer.

This is a family neighborhood so we ask that all your partying is done in the city, 10 pm noise curfew.

The space
Entire apartment with a private and secure entrance. Apartment equipped with Keurig coffee bar with pods, SmartTV (ready for your streaming logins). Please note we do not have live TV or cable. Strong Wi-fi signal and a Yale smart lock front door, which allows you to not worry about carrying keys around town. One parking spot available at the apartment, street parking nearby (200 ft) for any additional vehicles.
